_help: Chats and channels watched by agent/tg_monitor.py. Add an object to "chats": {"ref": "@username", "title": "optional label"}. ref can be @username, https://t.me/username or a numeric id (-100...). The account behind TG_SESSION must already be a member; private invite links (t.me/+...) cannot be used. Set "enabled": false to pause one chat. Do not put anything secret here if the repository is public.
